lines.speaker: Arthur
lines.text: Last one. I'm in the car because I can't do the stairs any more.

lines.speaker: Arthur
lines.text: Mercer's cabinet in the archive — the Trust papers are in it. I set the lock to the night. Month first, the American way, Thomas.

lines.speaker: Arthur
lines.text: I never got the book to talk. Forty years. It's not written for a Vale.

lines.speaker: Arthur
lines.text: If you're who I think you are, you won't need me for that part.

lines.speaker: Arthur
lines.text: Seven days. Don't let them hurry you. And keep the lamp lit.
